## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/test.mjs` passes
- [ ] An audit change has its failing case in `rules.test.mjs`, written before the fix
- [ ] New or moved files are linked from SKILL.md's reference map
- [ ] Nothing project-specific: no brand, token or path from your own app
- [ ] Claims about GSAP behaviour say which version they were verified against
- [ ] A new command or behaviour has an eval case in `plugins/gsap-motion/evals/`
- [ ] SKILL.md's word budget is unchanged, or the raise is explained below
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Version numbers are untouched (they change only in a release)
